messages.subject: Part 4 error message - GGIR 2.7-1 - GENEActiv accelerometer + sleep log
parts:
Hello everyone, 

I've been using GGIR to analyse raw physical activity data from GENEActiv accelerometer and it usually goes well. However, few days ago I got this new error message even though I've analysed some files successfully using the same scrip few weeks ago.

Below, I copied the error message and the script I used.
Any help to fix this issue would be much appreciated, thank you.

---------

Part 4 1Error in if (params_sleep[["relyonguider"]] == TRUE | relyonguider_thisnight == : argument is of length zero

---------

This is the script I'm using:

## Not run:
library(GGIR)
mode= c(1,2,3,4,5)
datadir= "C:/Users/psssmm/Desktop/DELIVER/Data" #Where is the data?
outputdir= "C:/Users/psssmm/Desktop/DELIVER/Output" #Where do you want to store the data?

     do.anglez=TRUE, # for sleep analysis
     do.angley=TRUE,
     do.anglex=TRUE,

     printsummary=TRUE,

     # Part 2 parameters:

     ndayswindow=7,

     hrs.del.end = 0,

     #-------------------------------

     frag.metrics="all",

     visualreport=TRUE)

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 4 error message - GGIR 2.7-1 - GENEActiv accelerometer + sleep log
parts:
I have not seen this error before, maybe try:

  • Remove the config.csv file from the output folder, as GGIR maybe be trying to re-use values from it that are not valid.
  • Install GGIR development version from GitHub, see instruction: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#21_Install_R_and_RStudio
  • Run GGIR with part 2 report only, and try to see whether this reveals any unusual results.

Cheers,

Vincent
